Color

Material 3 derives a full set of semantic color roles from a single source color via the dynamic-color engine in <m3e-theme>. Every role is a --md-sys-color-* token; the swatches below are live — change the source color, scheme, or contrast in the app bar settings and they re-derive.

Container pairings

Each accent comes as a bold role and a lower-emphasis container, and every role carries a paired on-* color for legible content. The swatch text is painted with that on-color, so if the label is readable the pairing is correct.

Primarybg-primary
Primary Containerbg-primary-container
Secondarybg-secondary

Dynamic color

<m3e-theme> wraps Material's material-color-utilities to derive a full scheme from a seed at runtime. Swap the source color in the app bar to see every role above re-derive instantly.

Forced colors

When the OS reports forced-colors (Windows High Contrast), components map their semantic roles onto the system palette automatically. No app changes required.

Test itEnable Windows High Contrast or `forced-colors: active` in dev tools. The swatches above stay legible because every role respects the forced palette.
